story_text:
As a customer, I want to pay for my order using credit card or PayPal so that I can complete my purchase.

AC1: Support Visa, Mastercard, Amex
AC2: PayPal redirect flow
AC3: 3D Secure for cards > €100
AC4: Payment failure shows clear error
AC5: Retry up to 3 times
AC6: Order status updates within 5 seconds
architecture_text: Payment module: src/payment/ with Stripe SDK for cards, PayPal REST API for PayPal. Webhook handler for async confirmations. Redis for idempotency keys. PostgreSQL for transaction log.

story_text:
As a user, I want to search products by name, category, and price range so that I can find what I need quickly.

AC1: Full-text search with typo tolerance
AC2: Filter by category (multi-select)
AC3: Price range slider (min/max)
AC4: Results sorted by relevance by default
AC5: Pagination: 20 per page
AC6: Search suggestions after 2 chars
architecture_text: Elasticsearch for search backend, Redis cache for popular queries, React frontend with debounced search input.
